headlines.title: New Supreme Court term begins with justices stumped by climate change case
headlines.description: The justices return from summer break to hear arguments in a lawsuit Boulder, Colorado, brought against Exxon Mobil and Suncor Energy.

headlines.title: As Trump pushes for data centers, voters in key midterm races say they don’t want them
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that 69% of respondents oppose building AI data centers in their areas, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: 'Dear Donald': Battleground district voters share their message to Trump
headlines.description: On his final day of the NBC News Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW from Nebraska to recap his trip and hisvisit to the “blue dot” district.

headlines.title: 'I am not running for president,' Attorney General Todd Blanche says at Iowa State Fair
headlines.description: On day five of his Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to break down his one-on-one with Attorney General Todd Blanche at the Iowa State Fair in Des Moines.

headlines.title: ‘Resign. You’re destroying the country’: Republican voter in key Ohio district slams Trump
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen cruises down I-80 in his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. On day 3 of his road trip, Jon Allen visits Ohio’s 7th and 9th congressional districts.

headlines.title: Some Democrats don’t expect to fill a Supreme Court vacancy under Trump
headlines.description: Minority Leader Chuck Schumer is putting President Donald Trump on notice: If Democrats win the Senate, they don’t intend to put “MAGA” judges on the courts.

headlines.title: Karoline Leavitt, former White House press secretary, joins Fox News as contributor
headlines.description: Fox News has signed former White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt as an on-air contributor, the conservative cable news network announced Monday.

headlines.title: Disgraced Former House Speaker Dennis Hastert Dies at 84
headlines.description: Former Rep. Dennis Hastert, who served eight years as speaker of the House and then spent more than a year in prison for scheming to cover up sexual abuse allegations, has died at the age of 84.

headlines.title: Supreme Court kicks off term with major climate change case
headlines.description: The Supreme Court is kicking off its new term with a major climate change case looking at whether energy companies can be sued for damages caused by climate change-related natural disasters. NBC News’ Lawrence Hurley has the details.

headlines.title: US Arrests California Woman on Suspicion of Spying for China
headlines.description: A 34-year-old woman was taken into custody at LAX by the FBI over the weekend, accusing her of spying on behalf of Chinese officials. NBC’s Janis Mackey Frayer reports for TODAY.
